title: Git Workflow & Commit Guidelines
branching_strategy: One Focused Branch per Task: Every task/feature MUST be developed on its own dedicated feature branch (e.g. feature/mod-03-online-reservation).
No Unrelated Changes: Never mix unrelated module changes or refactoring into a single branch.
Instruction Review Requirement: Developers and AI agents MUST read corresponding .ai/ instructions before creating a branch or editing code.
commit_standards_hygiene: Atomic & Descriptive Commits: Commits must be concise and describe specific changes (e.g. feat(mod-04): add schedule conflict date range validation).
Credential & Secret Protection: NEVER commit API secrets, private keys, service account credentials, .env files, or test dumps.
No Unsupported Dependencies: Do NOT commit package.json dependencies, node_modules, or build artifacts not approved in locked stack.
shared_file_contract_management: Shared Contract Rule: Modifying shared interfaces or database schemas MUST be formally proposed and logged in .ai/contract-change-log.json BEFORE merging.
Shared File Review: Modifying root config or shared helpers requires cross-checking impact across all ten modules.
No Incomplete Merges: Never merge code that breaks contracts, leaves failing tests, or violates schema rules.
